bio: This restaurant occupies the premises of the legendary Es Racó d'Es Teix. Today, under a new name, it has clearly reinvented itself with a much more casual concept run by the three daughters of the previous owner. The standout feature here continues to be the idyllic terrace with its stunning views over Deià and the Serra de Tramuntana, where you can choose between a concise, internationally inspired à la carte and a tasting menu (3- or 7-course options). It’s well worth booking one of the restaurant’s parking spaces as it is complicated finding a parking spot around the village....
